drivers: Financial underwriting: face amount plus in-force coverage far exceeds the income multiple for age
rationale: Face $2.5M plus $100K in force is $2.6M on $52K income; the age-44 allowance is 20x, about $1.04M. The manual refers a face this large relative to income to judgement; with no referral I postpone pending financial justification rather than issue two and a half times the supported amount on a whole-life premium this income cannot carry. Provisionally the medicals rate Table 2: treated hypertension above target and mildly elevated liver enzymes, the latter a judgement call.
